_comment: Address → display label overrides for stablecoins DefiLlama flattens (on-chain symbol is the same as the native token, so only a curated address map can tell them apart). Keyed by lowercased token contract address. Only VERIFIED addresses belong here — a wrong entry mislabels a pool. The build reconstructs a pool's shown symbol from its underlying-token addresses using these, keeping DefiLlama's label for anything not listed.
